_comment: Tests no pull request into feat-cmux-next runs, on purpose, each with the reason.
fails on any other test no such pull request runs, and on an entry here once one does.
Route a test (a job that runs on those pull requests, by the paths it tests) rather than add it here.

exemptions.reason: ci-guards.yml's `preflight` group. ci.yml runs it, routed by path (workflow_guard_groups.py), only for pull requests into main; cmux-next-guards.yml runs only the `ci` and `release-notary` groups. To route it, run the path-routed groups in cmux-next-guards.yml's CI guard group job, judged against the base.
A classic-app shell or CLI regression on a macOS runner lane (run_python_test_lane.py in ci-macos.yml). ci.yml calls ci-macos.yml only for pull requests into main; cmux-next has its own Mac tiers.
Registry lane `legacy` (migration inventory): no automatic lane runs it on either branch yet. Place it in a lane first.
No tests/test-execution.toml entry on the base (the registry check warns about it). Place it in a lane first.

ci-guards.yml's `release-ios` group. ci.yml runs it, routed by path (workflow_guard_groups.py), only for pull requests into main; cmux-next-guards.yml runs only the `ci` and `release-notary` groups. To route it, run the path-routed groups in cmux-next-guards.yml's CI guard group job, judged against the base. They test the classic iOS TestFlight and App Store upload workflows.

remote-daemon.yml, which ci.yml calls only for pull requests into main and main pushes.
ci-guards.yml's workflow-guard-history job (the SwiftPM lockfile policy), which only ci.yml's guards job runs, for pull requests into main.
ci-guards.yml's workflow-guard-source-lints job, which only ci.yml's guards job runs, for pull requests into main.

cmux-browser-host-release.yml runs it on feat-cmux-next pushes that touch the browser host. A pull request lane needs that release workflow to gain a pull_request trigger with its publish jobs gated off.
Only cmux-next-notices.yml runs it, on workflow_dispatch.
Only nightly-next-feed-watch.yml runs it, on a schedule (from main's copy).
Only the scripts/verify-local.py recipe runs it, and no pull request job runs the recipe. It tests the classic cmux.xcodeproj normalizer.
